brief:
Amjad al-Najjar, general director of the Palestinian Prisoners' Club, said Israeli occupation authorities are targeting more than 15 Palestinian institutions in the West Bank through raids, closures, property confiscation, and document seizure, Shehab Wire reported. The campaign aims to prevent human rights organizations from documenting and exposing Israeli actions internationally.

The targeting of rights groups represents a systematic effort to obstruct accountability mechanisms and limit international scrutiny of military operations in occupied Palestinian territory.
